name: Vault requirement
responsibility: Refuses a call that names no vault, a vault the server cannot read, or a directory that is not the .archboard/vault of one, before any handler runs
description: ADR 0049: every call names its vault as ?vault=<directory> or a vault field in its body. The refusal says how to name one (VAULT_REQUIRED, 400; VAULT_UNREADABLE, 404) and creates nothing. TASK-472.09: a vault whose real path is not <dir>/.archboard/vault is VAULT_UNREADABLE too, and the refusal says to move the boards there, because a workhorse works in the directory that holds the vault (ADR 0050) and such a vault has none. A handler reads the canonical vault with vaultOfRequest.
